purpose: Facts about the sources behind pinned lenalidomide files that the files themselves do not record: misprints, small differences between sources, and file identities. Each note points at the pinned file and value it concerns; none changes a value. Raised by the AI review of 10 November 2026 (docs/reviews/2026-11_fable_review.md); to be carried into each file's next version.

notes.note: The study-wide age '68 (62-74)' is transcribed as printed in Bridoux 2016 Table 1 (page 176), but it cannot be right: the group ranges span 48 to 84 years. Treat the total range as a misprint in the source; the per-group ranges are the ones to use.

EMA 2008 Table 4 prints the severe group's CL/F as '52 (101)'. An SD twice the mean is not plausible beside the group's other values; Chen 2007 Table II gives a geometric CV of 18% for the same six subjects, implying an SD near 9-10 mL/min. No calculation uses the SD; the body map shows it as a likely misprint.
The same statistic is printed as 6778 (14) in Chen 2007 Table II and as 6776 (14) in EMA II-0056 Table 3. Each file is faithful to its source; the 2 h·ng/mL difference is immaterial.

The pinned checksum is of the platform owner's text copy of the TGA report. The regulator's file, auspar-lenalidomide-160205-cer.docx (7,632,392 bytes), has SHA-256 a3655357387f586baee18dfdb2dba55b76979edee55f3872ddc6db29048d3f30 (10 November 2026). Checked against the .docx with scripts/check_source_quotes.py: three of the four quotes are found as stored; the population quote ends with a full stop where the report continues with a comma ('...to the PPK analysis, with the majority of subjects providing...'). The words and numbers are the report's.

Two source facts not yet in the assessment. (a) The control stream's output file is run016_cl_crcl2_ffm_vpc.fit and its covariate is CRCL2, so a second creatinine-clearance variable probably existed; that Table 1's CrCl is CRCL2 is an assumption. (b) Section 2.4 computes Cockcroft-Gault for simulated patients from sampled weight, height, age, creatinine and sex, again without naming the weight. Status stays unresolved; the question for the authors should ask what distinguishes CRCL2 from CRCL.

'Disease context not established' is out of date: CC-5013-PK-001 enrolled people with kidney impairment due to non-malignant conditions and healthy controls (recorded 31 October 2026 in renal_pk_group_evidence_v2.json and the reconciliation v3). The Chen 2017 quotes behind the exposure-safety time window are still to be checked against that PDF, which is not in the source folder.
